Old post, but I happened to be in this sub (post on tweaking the downvotes on the style sheet a smidgen) and it looks like you're still active, so here's a reply for you or for anyone else who stumbles in to this sub :)

Here's what I've used in v/Introductions for the user/mod flair you're looking for; the colors match those of the original Typogra theme. You're really not modding the CSS, you're just adding to it a bit and it changes nothing else in the theme.

You can simply copy and paste this into your style sheet area and make changes where indicated by "USER-NAME-HERE" and "FLAIR-TITLE-HERE":

/*== User | Mod Flair ==*/
/* this code below alters color, border shape, font size etc for every mod; use this only once; Leave This Alone, or don’t, that’s cool too */
.light #container a[href^="/user/"]::after { 
background: #a9bebb; 
border: 1px solid #587571; 
border-radius: 2px; 
font-size: .8em; 
color: #161d1d; 
letter-spacing: .1em;
margin-left: 4px; 
margin-right: 1px; 
padding: 1px 5px; 
vertical-align: middle;
 }

.dark #container a[href^="/user/"]::after { 
background: #638480; 
border: 1px solid #2c3a39; 
border-radius: 2px; 
font-size: .8em; 
color: #0e0e0e; 
letter-spacing: .1em;
margin-left: 4px; 
margin-right: 1px; 
padding: 1px 5px; 
vertical-align: middle; 
}

/*== Here’s where you specify each Mod or User and their Special Flair, uppercase & lowercase may be needed per user, must leave-in quote marks after content; adjust-copy-paste as many times as may be needed ==*/
#container a[href="/user/Dr_Moonman_III"]::after {
content: "Mod"; 
}
#container a[href="/user/Cynabuns"]::after {
content: "Random Voat User"; 
}
#container a[href="/user/cynabuns"]::after {
content: "Random Voat User"; 
}
#container a[href="/user/USER-NAME-HERE"]::after {
content: "FLAIR-TITLE-HERE"; 
}
